This course meets the requirement for a science with a lab. The course covers food and the science of cooking: the principles of transforming raw ingredients into something delicious. It covers the health benefits of food, the environmental impact of getting that food onto our tables, and preparation techniques.  In the Labs, you’ll be following recipes and cooking in groups. Science concepts covered include heat transfer, emulsions, Maillard reaction, protein denaturation, caramelization, and more.  Nutritional value of foods and sensory evaluation techniques will be discussed.
